digest.component_or_area: pytest hang budget and CI workflow configuration
propositions: The per-test hang budget was reduced from 300s to 20s, but legitimate whole-tree-scan tests on the coverage CI leg cost 18.7-29.93s of call time, placing them inside the new budget band and causing xdist worker crashes.

The timeout_method=thread setting kills xdist workers via os._exit(1) rather than raising a pytest verdict, making worker crashes invisible to Failed:Timeout detection and creating the appearance of zero timeouts.

Workflow-text fixes are inert on their own Verified gate run because the gate executes reusable workflows from trusted main, not the patchset, so a stale CLI flag in main overrides a patchset ini change due to pytest-timeout precedence CLI > INI.
The --dist loadgroup setting re-dispatches a crashed test to respawned workers, causing a cascade of repeated failures that burns toward the job timeout ceiling instead of failing fast.

Restoring timeout=300 in both pyproject.toml ini and _build-and-test.yml shared-tier lanes, with headroom contract tests validating budget >= 2x measured worst case and <= 600s, resolves the over-budget crash pattern.
